sources.access: Full publisher open-access HTML: original coefficients, ln definition, BMI derivation, 18–75 population, limitations read.
sources.scope: FLI logistic equation; waist cm, BMI kg/m², triglycerides mg/dL, GGT U/L. No individual steatosis/fibrosis diagnosis claimed.

sources.version: Tanaka et al. 2002, J Hum Hypertens 16:97–103, DOI10.1038/sj.jhh.1001307
sources.access: Indexed original PubMed abstract with all predicted-creatinine/sodium coefficients and population-only limitation; publisher full text unavailable to this audit.
sources.scope: Population mean sodium excretion, not individual salt intake. 591 Japanese INTERSALT items; external group 513. Potassium equation outside implemented scope.

sources.version: Hypertension Research 2021, real-world hypertensive outpatient primary study
sources.access: Indexed primary study methods equation explicitly states mg/dL÷10 conversion in urinary ratio.
sources.scope: Confirms unit implementation; does not remove original individual-use limitations.

sources.version: Sampson et al. 2021, Clin Chem 67:987–997, DOI10.1093/clinchem/hvab048
sources.access: Indexed original PubMed abstract: lbLDL equation and sdLDL subtraction, calibration route using Sampson-estimated LDL-C. PMC/publisher full text blocked in this audit.
sources.scope: Arithmetic of lbLDL=1.43LDL−0.14ln(TG)LDL−8.99 and sdLDL=LDL−lbLDL. Direct LDL variant is a local extension and is not represented as published clinical validation.

sources.version: Sampson et al. 2020, JAMA Cardiol 5:540–548, DOI10.1001/jamacardio.2020.0013
sources.access: Full original primary HTML study methods, TG≤800 mg/dL use, exclusions and limitations read; displayed equation artwork corroborated by ADLM equation.
sources.scope: Sampson–NIH LDL-C panel estimation; typeIII hyperlipidemia excluded; no automatic diagnosis.

sources.version: ADLM Guidance Document on the Measurement and Reporting of Lipids and Lipoproteins, 2024
sources.access: Indexed official ADLM document Eq4, coefficients and mg/dL terms.
